note: Team notes for the pilot day, from the Zocus WhatsApp group, plus what Claude read from the recordings at each refresh. One entry per conversation, keyed by the conversation number. Fields: rep (nickname), customer, segment, model / models (as the customer saw them), fuel, colour, value (rupees, set by hand), remarks (shown on the conversation), prices (what was quoted: m = model or variant, p = rupees or text, b = basis, at = time in the recording), tr_en (English for key transcript lines, keyed by the line's time), csv (any CSV column to override, for example objection_quote_en), stage (exploring, finalising or after_booking), payment, kind (delivery = a conversation after the sale, not a sales pitch), result_label, drop (true to leave the call out) with why.

tr_en.4:02: The Z8 Select manual comes to around 21.25 lakh; the automatic around 22.75 lakh.
tr_en.5:40: There is no discount on the Scorpio, there is a waiting period. When do you want the car?

264.remarks: Delivery-day conversation, not a sales pitch. The customer was taking delivery of a Scorpio N today and choosing accessories, which led to a dispute over the ceramic coating bundled into the booking deal. A store colleague helped with accessories, and the rep took phone calls part-way through. The customer raised cancelling the whole car over this amount (17:14 and 17:25); the rep said the full amount would be returned by cheque.

prices.m: Ceramic coating in the booking deal
prices.b: as agreed at booking; the customer wants it cancelled or done elsewhere

csv.summary_next: Settle the coating dispute before delivery: nothing was agreed.

tr_en.1:15: About the calculation I sent: have you got the quotation? It has the 1+2 plan, one year plus two years. If you add 1,100 rupees it becomes 3+3: three years own-damage and three years third party; three years full and three years third party.
tr_en.2:32: Do not keep the service here. Get it done somewhere closer to us.
tr_en.2:47: Instead of the coating you can take accessories.
tr_en.4:14: It costs 10,500. This is the whole list.
tr_en.6:21: There is no such rule. If you want it, you have to come here. Insurance, then the RTO process; after the payment is made we go ahead.

tr_en.11:36: Everything will not be needed anyway. Nothing like that, the rest would come to 30,000 rupees. If it cannot be cancelled and we do not need the whole set, what do we do? Let us settle at 20,000.
tr_en.11:53: That cannot be done. We cannot reduce the deal from how the car was booked.
tr_en.12:15: If you want the coating, bring the car in for the first service and I will get it done then.
tr_en.14:32: Look at this list, all of it can be fitted and will reach you by evening.
tr_en.15:52: The coating will be minus. I told you that if you want accessories in place of the coating, you can take them.
tr_en.16:44: No, not the company: whatever was agreed at booking time stays as it is. I told you that at booking.
tr_en.17:00: Then you could have done it tomorrow. Only these two amounts were left to pay; you had enough trust that we would take the car.
tr_en.17:08: If you cannot get that done, you can at least cancel the coating.
tr_en.17:11: No, the coating cannot be cancelled.
tr_en.17:25: We can even cancel the whole car, but this 30,000... (unclear in the audio; the rep answers that he is saying this over 30,000).

tr_en.7:01: Have you brought cash or will it be online?

264.payment: Final payment still to be settled: the rep asked whether it would be cash or online, the customer said cash (both possible), and the rep told him to work out the balance. Insurance and RTO follow once payment is in. The customer says only two amounts were left to pay.
